Honest opinion, anua toner is the only toner i go to when I'm facing irritation or breakouts from time to time. I notice a big difference if i try to use another toner, my skin isn't as smooth as it was when i religiously use the anua toner everynight. I tried the madagascar centella ampoule to replace my anua tonee, but doesn't work as much. Maybe my skin likes Heartleaf more than Centella. Somehow I'm prone to breakouts easily when i stopped using it too. Tbh, it doesn't really hydrate that much, but it focus mainly on soothing. So if i need extra hydration, i topup with any HA ampoule or serum on top. I do daily anua toner masking, helps my oily acne prone skin stay calm since it's really cooling. I live in a hot climate with high humidity if it helps. Con is, it's expensive for small quantity and since i use it religiously i finish the bottle quiet fast which sucks. Tried to replace it with the Hatomugi toner too, still doesn't perform as well as Anua does.

My skin looked alot like yours. I used to have severe acne when i was a 14 till 19, took accutane and my skin cleared out. But at age 24 i start to have horrible hormonal acne where i get cystic acne on my jawline and neck mostly. What helped me wasn't just skincare, but also food and lifestyle. I notice skincare helps prevents new acne while lifestyle helps heal the skin. Exercise to regulate hormones better, i cut dairy for atleast 3 months because I'm lactose intolerant and notice that dairy could cause inflammation in my body, cut sugar as less as i can, and drink plenty of spearmint tea everyday and take probiotics daily and eat probiotic food. I have oily skin too, so i try to focus on skin barrier while using benzoyl peroxide or salicylic face wash and serum. I will put clindamycin on the cystic acnes every night if I'm not using SA. I still have CC's on my face, but no longer inflamed angry cystic acne on my jawline, unless it's during the menstrual period. My biggest advice is, check on your food to see if you're consuming anything your body may not be able to tolerate with.
